external_math_inputs.name: Elementary wall mim-width lower bound

abstract_obstruction_family.base: Let W_n be an elementary wall with bipartition A_n disjoint_union B_n.
abstract_obstruction_family.subdivision: Subdivide every wall edge once; denote the new subdivision vertices by Z_n and the resulting graph by J_n.
per_layer_structure: Each z_e has exactly one neighbor in A_n and exactly one neighbor in B_n.
I1 is a disjoint union of stars.
I2 is a disjoint union of stars.
Hence I1 and I2 are P4-free, therefore P7-free.
abstract_obstruction_family.width_conclusion: The family J_n has unbounded mim-width by the imported wall/subdivision lower-bound facts.
abstract_obstruction_family.abstract_consequence: Two individually trivial P7-free layers can have a union-incidence graph of unbounded mim-width.

p7_free_survivor_completion_control.construction: Define Qhat_n = J_n plus all edges between A_n and B_n.
p7_free_survivor_completion_control.survivor_graph: Qhat_n[A_n union B_n] = complete bipartite K_{|A_n|,|B_n|}, hence 2-colorable.
proof_sketch: Any nonconsecutive survivor vertices on opposite sides A_n and B_n form a chord because A_n is complete to B_n.
Thus an induced path containing survivors from both A_n and B_n can contain only a tightly consecutive mixed survivor block.
Because Z_n is stable, a 7-vertex induced path needs survivor/component alternation sufficiently often; a mixed survivor block cannot realize the required chordless pattern.
Therefore all survivor vertices of a hypothetical induced P7 must lie entirely in A_n or entirely in B_n.
Then the whole path lies inside I1 or I2 together with Z_n, but each such layer is a star forest and hence P4-free, contradiction.

abstract_falsified_route.importance: Any positive bounded-layout theorem must use additional genuine CSZ/B0/PATH_CELL source restrictions.
